title: Bit-string output length bound
statement: Let $F$ be a finite-state Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet, and let $R,T\colon\mathbb{N}\to\mathbb{N}$. Suppose that on every input word $y$, $F$ halts within $T(|y|)$ steps with output the binary expansion of $R(|y|)$. Then for every Boolean word $x$, the length of the binary expansion of $R(|x|)$ is at most $T(|x|)$.
hypotheses_covered: $F$ is a finite Turing machine over Boolean symbols
For every input, $F$ computes the binary expansion of $R$ of the input length within the time bound $T$
